package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestMigration028DiagnosticAssessmentContractIsCompleteAndTerminal(t *testing.T) {
	payload, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/028_student_diagnostic_assessment.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	sql := string(payload)
	result := sql[strings.Index(sql, "CREATE TABLE student_diagnostic_assessment_result"):strings.Index(sql, "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION")]
	columns := []string{"attempt_id uuid PRIMARY KEY", "student_id uuid NOT NULL", "course_id uuid NOT NULL", "course_content_revision varchar(71)", "policy_version varchar(64)", "result_digest varchar(71)"}
	previous := -1
	for _, column := range columns {
		index := strings.Index(result, column)
		if index < 0 || index <= previous {
			t.Fatalf("result table is missing or misorders %q", column)
		}
		previous = index
	}
	if strings.Count(sql, "COMMIT;") != 1 || !strings.HasSuffix(strings.TrimSpace(sql), "COMMIT;") {
		t.Fatal("migration must have exactly one terminal COMMIT")
	}
	for _, expected := range []string{"onboarding_version bigint NOT NULL CHECK (onboarding_version >= 1)", "bootstrap_policy_version varchar(64) NOT NULL CHECK (bootstrap_policy_version = 'diagnostic-bootstrap-v1')", "bootstrap_context_digest varchar(71)", "plan_json->>'onboarding_version' = onboarding_version::text", "plan_json->>'bootstrap_policy_version' = bootstrap_policy_version", "plan_json->>'bootstrap_context_digest' = bootstrap_context_digest", "plan_json - ARRAY['schema'", "'bootstrap_context_digest'", "(\\.[0-9]+)?Z$", "^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$", "student_diagnostic_assessment_immutable", "BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE", "UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT", "command_kind='SUBMIT' AND task_id IS NOT NULL", "CHECK (id = plan_id)"} {
		if !strings.Contains(sql, expected) {
			t.Fatalf("migration missing %q", expected)
		}
	}
}
